items.prompt: For input ["ba","ab","ab"], what family line must be emitted after the group-count line?

options.why: Using a set of members would lose one occurrence of ab.
The occurrences must be sorted alphabetically within the family.
All three occurrences remain, sorted by their original ticker strings.
The output requires separated original tickers, not concatenated letters.

items.explanation: All three occurrences remain, sorted by their original ticker strings.
